title: [Grawood Farmstead, Field]
description: Several open air tents and booths stand on this fallow piece of ground, the untended soil rife with flowering weeds and sparse patches of grass.  Overhead, banners of cotton with blocky letters proclaiming games and wares flutter here and there from support poles.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west
location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest
